instruction: Search Tenor for "team celebration", take the first GIF result, download it, and save it to "$HOME/Desktop/gifgrep_download_2_2.gif".
reference_command:
first_url=$(gifgrep "team celebration" --source tenor --format url | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$first_url" ]; then
  echo "No GIF URL found for query: team celebration"
  exit 1
fi
curl -L "$first_url" -o "$HOME/Desktop/gifgrep_download_2_2.gif"
